description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $60 - $100 per hour 
 
 Role Type: Independent Contractor
 Location: Fully Remote
 Commitment: Part-Time, Approximately 10 Hours per Week
 Engagement: Ongoing, Project-Based
 Seniority: Individual Contributor to Director Level
 About the Opportunity
 A venture-backed AI research organization developing advanced AI platforms and physics-based foundation models for chemistry, materials science, and drug discovery is seeking experienced Preclinical R&D Scientists to support the development of AI-driven pharmaceutical research capabilities.
 The organization is expanding its technology into new areas of pharmaceutical development and is looking for professionals with hands-on expertise in Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs), bispecific antibodies, or multispecific antibodies .
 This opportunity is designed for scientists who have worked directly on preclinical drug discovery and development programs and have experience progressing drug candidates from early research toward clinical development.
 You will combine your practical wet-lab, scientific, and translational R&D experience with AI-focused research activities to help improve how next-generation models interpret scientific data, evaluate development decisions, and support pharmaceutical innovation.
 Your expertise will contribute directly to the development of AI systems designed to understand and reason through real-world drug discovery and development challenges.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Scientific Data Review: Review technical documentation, experimental findings, and real-world R&D datasets related to ADC and/or bispecific antibody development programs.
 Data Annotation & Classification: Label, classify, and annotate scientific datasets and AI-generated outputs to improve model accuracy, reliability, and performance.
 Scientific Decision-Making: Provide expert insights into critical preclinical R&D decisions, including target and modality selection, candidate optimization, development trade-offs, and scientific risk assessment.
 Dataset Quality Standards: Contribute to defining data structures, annotation guidelines, and quality standards for scientific dataset development and processing.
 Research Collaboration: Participate in expert discussions, technical interviews, and research engagements with the client team to provide domain-specific scientific perspectives.
 AI Model Improvement: Apply practical pharmaceutical R&D knowledge to help AI models better understand experimental data, preclinical development strategies, and drug discovery workflows.
 Required Qualifications
 Hands-On Preclinical R&D Experience – Mandatory: Direct, non-administrative experience in preclinical research and development at a biotechnology or pharmaceutical company that develops its own drug assets internally and has successfully advanced programs into clinical development.
 ADC or Bispecific Expertise – Mandatory: Direct professional experience working with Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs), bispecific antibodies, or multispecific antibody platforms.
 Core R&D Background – Mandatory: Experience in at least one of the following scientific or technical functions:
 Discovery Biology
 Medicinal Chemistry
 Protein or Antibody Engineering
 Computational Biology or Computational Drug Discovery
 In Vivo Research and Translational Science
 Pharmacology and PK/PD
 Toxicology
 CMC or Formulation Development
 Industry Experience: At least 5 years of relevant pharmaceutical or biotechnology R&D experience. Candidates with deeper specialized expertise may be considered with flexibility around the experience requirement.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Drug Development Experience: Experience taking a drug discovery program through lead optimization, IND-enabling studies, or preclinical development.
 Biotech Experience: Previous experience working at emerging, mid-sized, or resource-constrained biotechnology companies, particularly organizations developing proprietary drug assets.
 Industry Background: Experience outside the top 20 global pharmaceutical companies is preferred, especially where you have had direct ownership of scientific and development decisions.
 Important Role Considerations
 This is a hands-on preclinical R&D position requiring direct involvement in drug discovery and development activities.
 The opportunity may not be suitable for candidates whose experience is primarily limited to:
 CRO or CDMO service-based work.
 Academic or university research without relevant industry R&D experience.
 Quality Control (QC) or analytical testing alone.
 Clinical development without preclinical R&D involvement.
 Diagnostics or diagnostic product development.
 Regulatory affairs or medical writing.
 Engagement Details
 Work Arrangement: Fully remote, with flexible working hours.
 Weekly Commitment: Approximately 10 hours per week.
 Engagement Type: Ongoing, part-time independent contractor engagement.
 Client Interaction: Direct collaboration and communication with the client’s research team.
 Seniority: Professionals ranging from Individual Contributors to Directors are welcome.
 Project duration and scope may be extended, reduced, or concluded early depending on project requirements and performance.
 Contract & Payment Terms
 Independent Contractor Engagement: Selected candidates will be engaged as independent contractors.
 Flexible Work Schedule: Work can be completed remotely according to your availability and project requirements.
 Weekly Payments: Compensation will be paid weekly through Stripe or Wise based on services completed.
 Confidentiality: The engagement will not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
 Work Authorization: H-1B and STEM OPT candidates cannot be supported for this engagement at present.
 Ideal Candidate Profile
 The ideal candidate is an experienced pharmaceutical or biotechnology R&D scientist with direct involvement in ADC or bispecific antibody development and a strong understanding of preclinical drug discovery.
